ms.report:
A. Output: 25 Articles with an overview of the projects. 
Acceptance criteria:
・Each article must be at least 500 words long.
・Articles should provide a detailed description of each project, including goals, standout features, and potential impact.
・Articles should focus on cover the project in terms of how it uses cardano's blockchain technology.
・Articles must be well-written and free of grammatical errors. 

Evidence: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VS0Q86LCJevpEPjyHJt0TRcyZ_SbWMP597l0jRRWgAU/edit?usp=sharing]
Note: There is a link for the article in the newsletter website and another link for the article in the personal website.
B. Output: 25 Written tutorials.
Acceptance criteria:
・Each tutorial must be clear and easy to follow, with step-by-step instructions. 
・Tutorials should cover relevant aspects of each project, such as gameplay, game mechanics, or installation.
・Tutorials must be available in an accessible format for the target audience, such as PDF or web pages. 

Evidence: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VS0Q86LCJevpEPjyHJt0TRcyZ_SbWMP597l0jRRWgAU/edit?usp=sharing]
Note: It is the same link as above because that is where you will find the link to the tutorial on my personal website and the tutorial embedded within the article on the newsletter website.
C. Output: 25 Video gameplays.
Acceptance criteria:
・Each gameplay video must be a minimum of 10 minutes long.
・It should showcase key aspects of the game, such as gameplay, graphics, and unique mechanics.
・Gameplays must be recorded with a minimum quality of 720p.

Evidence: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14TUVO9fkn1bESgHt0lUQvwcu-NlXpOLeotCsgHjvkdA/edit?usp=sharing
D. Output: A report document detailing project progress, including a summary of milestone execution, challenges encountered, and lessons learned
Acceptance criteria: The report will collect stats as evidence, the following stats will be included in the report:
・Number of views for the articles on the Newsletter webs
